slug: 2019-06-01 The CRVS and Identity Eco-System in the Republic of Mauritius (presentation)

facts.fact: The Registrar of Civil Status states in June 2019 that all civil events have been registered online since November 2001, the Division's services being registration of birth, death and marriage, with 100 per cent registration claimed.

The Registrar states that civil events are registered online since November 2001 at computerised civil status offices in the district of the event or residence, a national identity number being computer generated on each birth registered and the data shared through the Central Population Database.

The Registrar lists 35 Civil Status Offices around the island by district, including two in Rodrigues (the cover slide says 33), describes them as computerised civil status offices and says all civil events are registered online; the deck does not say in terms that every office enters records.
The system is presented as the Civil Status Division's own, the Division being under the Prime Minister's Office and headed by the Registrar of Civil Status, who gives the presentation.

systems.owner: Civil Status Division, Prime Minister's Office
systems.tiers: 35 Civil Status Offices listed by district (Port Louis headquarters and sub office, eight other districts, Rodrigues); online since November 2001; generates the national identity number at birth registration and deactivates it at death; re-engineering listed as way forward

systems.owner: Civil Status Division, Prime Minister's Office
systems.tiers: Central; servers at the Government Online Data Centre; holds latest data of citizens for sharing
Central; 30 subscribers connected to CSD and 45 CSD e-services, 86 subscribers and 401 e-services nationwide; shares CSD data with ministries and departments

systems.country_label: Mauritius National Identity Card; electronic NIC system
systems.owner: Civil Status Division, Prime Minister's Office
systems.tiers: 3 MNIC units and a mobile team for bedridden citizens; electronic since 2009, smart card since 2013; 1,666,808 smart cards issued to date

systems.system: Online application for civil status extracts
systems.owner: Civil Status Division, Prime Minister's Office
systems.tiers: Listed as way forward, not stated as live

systems.system: Link from Ministry of Health and private clinics to the Civil Status Division
systems.tiers: Planned, to reduce late declaration of birth; hospitals and clinics currently issue a notification of birth
